records.text: This deliberate incapacitation of the enforcement mechanism gave a green light to foreign influence operatives, ensuring that the Knesset's 2018 plan to skirt FARA could proceed with minimal risk of prosecution, shifting resources in the National Security Division.
records.speaker: Ian Carroll
